{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check if the groups are comparable: cross-tabulate arm with other key variables
print('Cross-tabulation of arm vs severity:')
print(pd.crosstab(trial_df['arm'], trial_df['severity']))

print('\nCross-tabulation of arm vs sex:')
print(pd.crosstab(trial_df['arm'], trial_df['sex']))

print('\nCross-tabulation of arm vs age (mean):')
print(trial_df.groupby('arm')['age'].mean())"}
